value.answer: Call 911 now or go to the ER right now - a fever with purple spots that do not fade when pressed can be a sign of serious infection needing urgent treatment.
value.triage: Go to the ER or call 911 immediately - do not wait or call 811 for this. While waiting for help, keep checking the rash and watch for worsening drowsiness, breathing trouble, or the rash spreading.
